check: Four halvings imply a population of 60 × 2^4 = 960 after the moves. The original population was 960 - 100 + 400 = 1,260.
evidence_quote: Before the new people moved in, the population was 480 people.
error_description: The solution reverses only three of the four halvings and identifies the year-one population as the original population. It also omits reversing the arrival of 100 people and departure of 400.
